boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along the commercial and cultural corridors surrounding Fordham’s Rose Hill campus, each paired with one sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Follow the Bread to Addeo
cards.subtitle: Hughes Avenue corridor · 2372 Hughes Avenue
cards.notes: Walk south on Hughes Avenue and look for the family bakery; choose among its documented breads, biscuits, breadsticks, and pizza dough.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood bread counter on the Hughes Avenue side of Bronx Little Italy.
cards.evidence_claim: Addeo Bakers identifies its 2372 Hughes Avenue location and lists bread, biscuits, breadsticks, pizza dough, and other traditional products.
cards.access_notes: Public retail bakery; consult the business directly for current storefront hours and availability.

cards.title: Pause for Pastry at Artuso
cards.subtitle: East 187th Street corridor · 670 East 187th Street
cards.notes: Continue along East 187th Street to the named pastry shop; visit the counter or use its documented pickup ordering option.
cards.short_summary: A pastry storefront that gives East 187th Street a clearly photographed dessert stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Belmont Business Improvement District lists Artuso Pastry at 670 East 187th Street and states that customers can order for in-store pickup.
cards.access_notes: Public pastry shop; the source lists daily opening hours, but confirm them before visiting.

cards.title: See the Cheese Counter at Casa
cards.subtitle: East 187th Street corridor · 604 East 187th Street
cards.notes: Find the deli on East 187th Street and make its mozzarella counter the single reason for this block; expect a purchase if you order.
cards.short_summary: A named specialty deli anchoring a food-focused stretch of East 187th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Belmont Business Improvement District identifies Casa Della Mozzarella as a delicatessen at 604 East 187th Street.
cards.source_title: Casa Della Mozzarella - Bronx Little Italy
cards.access_notes: Public delicatessen; the source lists daytime hours seven days a week, subject to change.

cards.title: Browse Espresso Gear at Cerini
cards.subtitle: Arthur Avenue corridor · 2334 Arthur Avenue
cards.notes: Step onto Arthur Avenue to browse coffee beans, espresso machines, accessories, and housewares at the documented storefront.
cards.short_summary: An Arthur Avenue shop centered on coffee equipment and imported pantry goods.
cards.evidence_claim: Cerini’s official site places the shop at 2334 Arthur Avenue and lists coffee beans, espresso machines, accessories, food products, and housewares.
cards.source_title: Espresso Coffee Machines, Grinders & Beans – Cerini Coffee & Gifts
cards.access_notes: Public retail shop; its official site lists Monday–Saturday hours and says it is closed Sunday.

cards.title: Read the Storefront’s Family History
cards.subtitle: Arthur Avenue corridor · 2372 Arthur Avenue
cards.notes: Stop at the Arthur Avenue corner grocery and notice the setting behind its documented century-old family story and Italian inventory.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding Arthur Avenue grocery with a documented Austrian Jewish family history.
cards.evidence_claim: Teitel Brothers’ official history says the Arthur Avenue grocery has operated for more than 100 years and sells Italian goods including olive oil, vinegar, and salami.
cards.source_title: The Jewish History of an Italian Grocery Store – Teitel Brothers
cards.access_notes: Public grocery storefront; verify current hours directly with the business before visiting.

cards.title: Catch an Early Bakery Stop
cards.subtitle: East 187th Street corridor · 691 East 187th Street
cards.notes: Approach from the eastern end of East 187th Street and use the bakery’s documented early opening as the reason to start here.
cards.short_summary: An early-opening bakery storefront toward the eastern end of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Belmont Business Improvement District lists Terranova Bakery at 691 East 187th Street and reports a 6 a.m. opening seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Public bakery; the source lists a 6 a.m. opening, with earlier Sunday closing than Monday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel Church
cards.title: Look Up at the Twin Towers
cards.subtitle: East 187th Street corridor · 627 East 187th Street
cards.notes: Pause outside on East 187th Street to examine the twin-towered Romanesque facade, wheel window, portals, and detailed brickwork.
cards.short_summary: A visually distinct church facade marking the center of the East 187th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Belmont BID’s walking tour places the church at 627 East 187th Street and describes its Romanesque design, twin towers, triple portal, wheel window, and brickwork.
cards.access_notes: View the exterior from the public sidewalk; services and interior access follow the parish schedule.

cards.entity_name: Belmont Library and Enrico Fermi Cultural Center
cards.title: Find the Italian Heritage Collection
cards.subtitle: East 186th Street corridor · 610 East 186th Street
cards.notes: Turn onto East 186th Street and explore the branch’s Italian-language and Italian American history materials across three floors.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop whose collections connect directly to the surrounding district.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL places the branch at 610 East 186th Street and says its Enrico Fermi collection includes Italian-language materials and works on Italian American history.
cards.source_title: About the Belmont Library and Enrico Fermi Cultural Center
cards.access_notes: Fully accessible public library; check the location page for current daily hours and holiday closings.

cards.title: Enter a 250-Acre Plant Map
cards.subtitle: Southern Boulevard corridor · 2900 Southern Boulevard
cards.notes: Follow Southern Boulevard to the Main Entrance, then use the official map to locate named gardens, collections, trails, and exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A large botanical destination bordering Rose Hill’s eastern side.
cards.evidence_claim: NYBG identifies its Main Entrance at 2900 Southern Boulevard and provides an interactive map covering collections and exhibitions across 250 acres.
cards.source_title: NYBG Map | Interactive Map & Mobile Guide
cards.access_notes: Ticketed garden; consult NYBG’s official visit pages for current admission, hours, and entry requirements.

cards.title: Use the Zoo’s Southern Boulevard Gate
cards.subtitle: Southern Boulevard corridor · 2300 Southern Boulevard
cards.notes: Continue down Southern Boulevard to the zoo’s documented address and use its official interactive map to plan an animal-exhibit route.
cards.short_summary: A major wildlife destination directly across from Fordham’s campus orbit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bronx Zoo’s official contact page gives its address as 2300 Southern Boulevard and directs visitors to an interactive map with real-time park information.
cards.access_notes: Ticketed zoo; verify current admission, operating hours, gate availability, and reservation requirements before departure.
